details.description: Gemma 3 27B-it is the largest instruction-tuned model in Google DeepMind's Gemma 3 family, a multimodal model that accepts text and image input and generates text output over a 128K-token context window, per Google's Gemma 3 model card. It was trained on 14 trillion tokens with an August 2024 knowledge cutoff and supports data spanning over 140 languages. Google's current developer docs now group Gemma 3 under "previous Gemma models," with Gemma 4 listed as the current generation, though Gemma 3's weights remain downloadable.
advantages: Scores 87.8 on HumanEval and 95.9 on GSM8K, per Google's Gemma 3 model card.
Scores 42.4 on GPQA Diamond and 67.5 on MMLU (Pro), per Google's Gemma 3 model card.
Scores 87.6 on BIG-Bench Hard and 64.9 on MMMU (val), per Google's Gemma 3 model card.
Trained on data spanning over 140 languages, per Google's Gemma 3 model card.
Handles text and image input, encoding each image at 896x896 resolution as 256 tokens, per Google's model card.
disadvantages: Superseded by Gemma 4, which Google's developer docs list as the current Gemma generation, with Gemma 3 grouped under "previous Gemma models."
Knowledge cutoff of August 2024, per Google's Gemma 3 model card.
Google's model card notes the model can struggle with subtle nuance, sarcasm, or figurative language, and may generate incorrect or outdated factual statements.
use_cases: Multimodal question answering and image content analysis
Creative text generation such as scripts and marketing copy

notes: Catalog's max_output_tokens differs by provider (8000 for the Bedrock entry vs 131072 for Fireworks); Google's model card states total output context up to 128K tokens for the 4B/12B/27B sizes after subtracting input tokens, but kept each provider's catalog value per instructions. The Hugging Face card's auto-extracted benchmark table returned notably lower numbers (e.g. HumanEval 48.8, MMLU 78.6 on a different scale) than Google's official Gemma 3 model card for the 27B IT variant (HumanEval 87.8, MMLU Pro 67.5); those HF figures look like they came from a different table (base/PT or a different metric), so evaluations above use only the IT numbers from Google's official model_card_3 page, re-confirmed on a second fetch. Google's current docs now group Gemma 3 under 'previous Gemma models' with Gemma 4 listed as current, though no formal deprecation date is given.
